newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ICI says ICI Plc to offer stake to public.
newsitem.headline: ICI says ICI Plc to offer stake to public.

text.p: Chemicals group ICI Australia Lttd said on Wednesday that its 62.4 percent shareholder, Imperial Chemical Industries Plc, would sell off its stake by way of a public offering to institutional and retail investors with as many shares as practicable to be sold by the end of 1997.
ICI Australia said the offer would be made to both local and international investors with Goldman Sachs appointed to advise ICI Plc while Centaurus Corporate Finance would advise ICI Australia.
The companies said they had agreed to enter into discussions to consider the basis on which existing commercial relationships between them will continue.
Based on Wednesday's closing price of A$12.44, ICI Plc's 185 million ICI Australia shares are valued at A$2.3 billion.
